task.description: Design the entity_definitions migration, CRUD context module, artifact_kind extension, and activation wiring for REQ-226.

result.note: Design written to lib/letflow/design/req226-entity-definitions-persistence-crud.md. Key decisions: (1) entity_definitions table -- tenant-scoped per-tenant Postgres schema (Decision B), columns id/tenant_id/name/display_name/definition_json/content_hash/logical_shape_version/artifact_version_id(FK->artifact_versions, on_delete: :restrict)/status(Ecto.Enum :active|:inactive)/inserted_at, UNIQUE(tenant_id, name, logical_shape_version) named entity_definitions_tenant_name_shape_idx, plus supporting indexes for name lookup, cursor listing, and content_hash tracing; no immutability trigger yet (OQ-2, no update/delete path exists). (2) artifact_kind.ex: append :entity as 8th atom to @artifact_kinds and the @type t union -- confirmed non-structural, no code elsewhere switches exhaustively on the list. (3) Three-module split: Letflow.Entities.EntityDefinition (new Ecto.Schema, lib/letflow/entities/entity_definition.ex), Letflow.Entities.Definitions (new CRUD context module, lib/letflow/entities/definitions.ex, functions create_definition/2, get_definition/2, get_definition_by_name/2, list_definitions/2, activate_definition/4), distinct from REQ-225's singular Letflow.Entities.Definition document-shape module. create_definition/2 validates via REQ-225's Validator first (rejects before any DB write), then calls Letflow.Repository.create/2 with artifact_kind: :entity, then inserts the entity_definitions row. list_definitions/2 matches Letflow.Repository.list_versions/4's REQ-067 cursor contract exactly (own 'ED:' cursor tag, (inserted_at,id) seek key). activate_definition/4 is a thin wrapper: calls Repository.Activation.activate_group/5 unchanged (no new activation table/mechanism), then syncs entity_definitions.status as a local read-convenience denormalisation. (4) Dedup semantics traced end-to-end for both AC4 scenarios (different names -> 2 entity_definitions rows sharing 1 repository_artifacts row; same name+shape -> UNIQUE-constraint rejection, with OQ-1 flagging that create/2 still mints a redundant artifact_versions row first since no pre-check exists). (5) Full error taxonomy table (validation / repository / persistence-uniqueness / not_found / invalid_schema_name / pagination errors / activation-group errors) with exact tuple shapes. Traceability table maps all 8 ACs to design sections. Three open questions stated explicitly (OQ-1 redundant-version-on-resubmit, OQ-2 immutability trigger deferral, OQ-3 status-filtered lookup) rather than silently resolved.
